title: MeeMeows
description:
This mod brings Aphmau's MeeMeows to Minecraft Forge 1.20.1 as 
 Pets!!!
body:
![Overview](https://i.imgur.com/cdUvfxD.png)
![bring aphmaus meemeows to minecraft](https://i.imgur.com/F1HdUZv.png)
![Trade to get blind bags!](https://i.imgur.com/p3BxOqL.png)
![Random meemeow on right click](https://i.imgur.com/0Kstjhr.png)
![more to come](https://i.imgur.com/qoPKTy3.png)
![Merchant table can be crafted to get trades](https://i.imgur.com/mFXvWKR.png)

![MeeMeows Varients include the following](https://i.imgur.com/vXYlrGp.png)
![Celestial](https://i.imgur.com/wpCPBDL.jpg)
![Treats](https://i.imgur.com/87fxdSR.jpg)
![and more](https://i.imgur.com/BNiiMAL.jpg)
![made with mcreator](https://i.imgur.com/pxFHvi5.png)

This mod adds tons of Aphaus MeeMeows Into Minecraft!
They can be obtained by trading with a special merchant!
The workbench for said trades can be crafted!
  I plan on adding almost all if not all MeeMeows in various updates soon to come. And i also plan on adding some fan made ones as well <3

I also plan on adding more animations for MeeMeows and sounds!

FEEL FREE TO USE IN MODPACKS!!!
Leave a comment which one you would like to see get added the most!
